name: Europäischer Fernwanderweg E4 (von Salzburg nach Gresten)
description_md:
The Europäischer Fernwanderweg E4 (von Salzburg nach Gresten) is a 265.7 km waymarked hiking route in Austria. It is part of an international waymarked hiking network and is signposted as E4.

Its difficulty is hard, which is derived from distance and ascent. The route passes Nonnberg within 400 m, Archbishopric of Salzburg within 700 m, and Salzburg within 1100 m.
